page_topic_one_liner: GitHub README as growth asset — Answer-First titles, badge trust signals, Quick Start conversion, and SEO/GEO optimization
differentiator_vs_generic: This is a README-as-landing-page guide for developer adoption, NOT generic documentation tips. Hero must be a GitHub repo README preview mockup with badge row + Quick Start code block — NOT a magnifying glass SEO graphic or generic code editor.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): GitHub-style README preview panel — Answer-First H1 title blur, 3 shields.io-style badge chips (License MIT, ★ stars, Last commit), highlighted Quick Start bash code block with copy icon, blurred file-tree sidebar strip on left edge
Secondary: conversion funnel strip — Visitor → Quick Start → Star/Fork with arrow connectors
Tertiary: scannable use-cases table row blur (2-column table fragment)
anti_patterns: Generic SEO magnifying glass (page is README marketing not SERP)
Blank markdown editor without badge/code structure
Real GitHub logo or real repo screenshots with usernames
